slides.title: Carry it in your pocket, for real
slides.body: Add Ocean Flow to your phone's home screen and open it like any other app — the prompt is on Home.

slides.title: Home, more useful at a glance
slides.body: The card at the bottom now tells you which school was most active this month, instead of repeating a figure you already see above.

slides.title: A color for every movement type
slides.body: Commissions and Adjustments now have their own brand color — recognizable at a glance, just like Course already was.

slides.title: Mi trabajo's KPIs, clearer than ever
slides.body: Each figure's icon shrinks smoothly if the number is long, and its color always stays visible next to the label.

slides.title: Revisit it whenever you want
slides.body: Find this again from Help → "What's new", any time you like.
